tips_en: Start with Paper 3 (ProWAM) — its progressive sub-goal imagination concept is intuitive and the clearest demonstration of how world action models can balance efficiency and long-horizon guidance for robot control. Then read Paper 2 (NAVA-WAM), which shares the same Mixture-of-Transformers backbone but tackles a complementary problem of learning action priors from observation-only videos, making them an ideal pair for understanding the current WAM landscape. Paper 1 (Kandinsky 6.0) is topically separate (audio-video generation) and can be read independently as a self-contained contribution on multimodal diffusion.
